meta.notes: The four-node LangGraph/Gemini shape — generate_queries → web_research → reflect → finalize — offered as an ENGINE option beside the five-phase pair. A THIRD document on purpose: the committed pair (pipeline-server / pipeline-secure) is pinned to the same spine shape as each other, because the headline structural claim is that the two TIERS run the same research in different places. This document is a different TOPOLOGY, not a different tier, so it must not be folded into that pair. Every node is a direct JSON-mode or streamed call (invariant 1); both planning nodes are pinned to the reliable JSON model (invariant 3); the loop edge is optional work that degrades to the wave already collected (invariant 2). Retrieval and the writer are the same code the server pipeline runs — this document describes which nodes exist, not a second implementation of them.

phases.title: One planning call: search angles, a rationale, and whether any source is needed

failure.degradesTo: model-free angles seeded from the conversation (seedFromConversation)

phases.title: Search waves through the existing engine — named pages first, then the planned angles

failure.degradesTo: fewer or zero sources; the answer still streams

phases.title: The one loop edge: is the evidence enough, and what gap remains stated?

failure.degradesTo: current coverage accepted, no follow-up wave

phases.title: Streamed answer on the user's chosen model, carrying the stated gaps as limitations
